name: PublishRelease
description: Generate release notes for a tag from the merged pull requests and publish the release to the project wiki (release pages and a Renovate-compatible releases.json).
helpMarkDown: Needs the job access token with Contribute on the wiki repository and Read on the source repository. See the extension README.
author: ado-releases

inputs.name: tag
inputs.label: Tag
inputs.helpMarkDown: Tag of the release, e.g. `tools/acme/v1.2.3` or `v1.2.3`.

inputs.name: previousTag
inputs.label: Previous tag
inputs.helpMarkDown: Default: the highest tag of the same package below the new version (pre-releases skipped for stable versions).

inputs.name: package
inputs.label: Package
inputs.helpMarkDown: Default: the tag prefix, or the repository name for `v1.2.3` tags.

inputs.name: pathFilter
inputs.label: Path filter
inputs.helpMarkDown: Only changes below this path, e.g. `/src/tools/acme` in a monorepo.

options.auto: When the version has a pre-release part

inputs.name: createTagOnCommit
inputs.label: Create tag on commit
inputs.helpMarkDown: Create the annotated tag on this commit when it does not exist yet, e.g. `$(Build.SourceVersion)`.

inputs.name: wikiProject
inputs.label: Wiki project
inputs.helpMarkDown: Default: the project of the repository.

inputs.name: wikiBranch
inputs.label: Wiki branch
inputs.helpMarkDown: Default: the default branch of the wiki repository.

inputs.name: dryRun
inputs.label: Dry run
inputs.helpMarkDown: Generate the notes and list the planned wiki files without creating tags or pushing.

outputVariables.name: releaseUrl
outputVariables.description: Web URL of the release page.
